title: Security-first architecture
description: Threat modelling and data-flow review happen during design, not as a pre-launch checklist.

title: Encrypted in transit and at rest
description: Modern transport security on every connection, with stored records encrypted and keys managed separately from data.

title: Role-based access
description: Least-privilege access by clinical role, so people reach the records their work requires and no more.

title: Audit logging
description: Every read and write against a patient record is logged, making access reviewable after the fact.

title: FHIR-ready interoperability
description: Standards-based exchange rather than bespoke integrations, so data portability is a property of the design.

title: Privacy-conscious by design
description: Data minimisation and clear consent boundaries, with analytics that never carry identifiable health information.
